validationIssues.detail: Initial TCP request failed its expected-success assertion. Baseline returned RCODE 0/two answers; one current-version confirmation independently passed. This does not prove transient network causation or TCP reliability. Initial body was not decoded after the failure-header assertion.

Baseline control wrongly expected the TCP failure to repeat. It instead observed RCODE 0/two answers. The hypothesis was refuted; failed assertion retained. This is not a demonstrated baseline transport failure.

Fixture cleanup expected 410 but observed 503. Downloaded unchanged fixture source explicitly returns 503 before route processing when EXPIRES_AT <= Date.now(); EXPIRES_AT remained 0 and active version unchanged. Source inspection resolved the expectation error without another request.
Some failed Node assertions also triggered Windows UV_HANDLE_CLOSING abort output. All HTTP attempts had already been durably recorded; failed records were not replaced.

First restoration reverse-patch anchor check stopped before upload due to string escaping. Base64-encoded original fragments then reproduced the original SHA before upload; independent readback verified restoration.

verification.reason: User requires cloud-only behavioral tests. Earlier 536-check result is historical only.
